purpose: Pre-register the implementation and comparison of a chemistry-aware Agent V5 before any V5 API result is generated. V5 must use experimentally discovered rheological regularities and their applicability domains as executable scientific constraints rather than as prose-only context.
provenance_rule: Author-authorized pre-result amendment. Preserve configs/archive/agent_v5_comparison_protocol_v1_0.json verbatim. V5 v1.1 clarifies information parity and V4-manifest drift handling before any V5 API outcome exists. Do not modify or reinterpret frozen V3/V4 run records. Any later protocol change after V5 results exist requires author-authorized thaw -> versioned revision -> re-freeze.

historical_reference.role: historical provenance baseline; not by itself a causal estimate of the chemistry gate because the architecture and prompts differ from V5

primary_controlled_arms.description: Advice-only control. The chemistry-audited local science summary and the same raw applicability audit facts visible to V5_FULL are available to the model, but applicability does not change card admissibility. All pre-gate experiment cards remain selectable if otherwise valid.
primary_controlled_arms.scientific_role: same-runtime control isolating the incremental effect of turning identical scientific applicability information into an executable hard constraint

primary_controlled_arms.description: Hard-gate condition. The model receives the same chemistry-audited local science summary and raw applicability audit facts as V5_NO_GATE; the deterministic applicability rule is additionally enforced before VOI ranking and at freeze.
primary_controlled_arms.scientific_role: prospective chemistry-aware Agent V5 with executable scientific constraints

secondary_context_arms.description: Previously frozen V4 evidence. Report as historical architecture context, not as a same-condition causal gate comparison.
Optional diagnostic replay of V4 using the same current model endpoint as V5. If run, label diagnostic and keep separate from original frozen V4.

Optional diagnostic condition in which deterministic V5 admissibility and VOI policy select the experiment without model-mediated override. Use only to attribute rule-layer versus model-layer contribution.

rule: M-HOLD-120 remains admissible if otherwise allowed because it directly measures thermal-hold drift and does not require the shared thermal-response shape.
M-REPEAT remains admissible if otherwise allowed because it directly measures realization/state spread.
M-SWEEP remains admissible and is the required verification measurement for chemistry-shifted candidates.
M-ANCHOR is admissible only when shared_shape_use == 'allowed_with_state_anchor', or when a versioned prior direct M-SWEEP for that same chemistry has explicitly verified transferability.
For resin-modified or otherwise chemistry-shifted candidates with no prior verified sweep, M-ANCHOR must be marked inadmissible_before_shape_verification rather than merely assigned a soft penalty.

primary_comparison_question: Given identical model-visible scientific applicability information, does converting the discovered chemistry-domain boundary from advice-only context into a hard executable constraint reduce unsupported experiment choices while preserving or improving hypothesis discrimination?

primary_metrics.definition: fraction of committed selections that use M-ANCHOR outside validated shared-shape support without prior direct shape verification
fraction of committed selections that violate any deterministic V5 applicability rule
existing experiment-card hypothesis-discrimination component under the unchanged registry
whether the selected measurement directly observes its claimed scientific quantity inside its validated domain
report attempted, completed, committed, abstained and invalid runs separately
selection diversity across repeated runs, with abstention as its own category

forbidden_primary_metrics: distance to the held-out validation formulation
frequency of selecting a preferred resin family as an end in itself
post-result closeness to S1C39 or S1C41
any metric containing held-out wet-lab outcome information

run_design.only_intended_difference_between_primary: whether the identical chemistry-domain applicability audit is enforced as hard experiment-card admissibility before VOI/freeze

required_outputs: full experiment-card inventory with admissible/inadmissible status and reason
model-visible pre-enforcement payload hash for each primary arm
applicability audit visible-to-model flag and enforcement flag
success_interpretation: A useful V5 result is not 'the Agent picked the expected formulation'. It is evidence that experimentally discovered material regularities and their chemistry-domain boundaries can be converted into executable constraints that prevent scientifically unsupported measurements while preserving or improving hypothesis discrimination.
manuscript_boundary: Do not add V5 run results to MAIN_TEXT_V5.md or its SI until implementation, blindness, parity and result audits are complete and the author explicitly freezes the V5 result series.

information_parity.requirement: V5_NO_GATE and V5_FULL must expose the same scientific facts to the model before the enforcement step.
same_across_primary_arms: raw assess_shared_shape_applicability outputs for the same candidate set
arm_specific_difference: V5_NO_GATE records applicability audit but does not remove cards or reject a committed card solely for chemistry-domain inadmissibility.
V5_FULL converts the same applicability audit into hard measurement admissibility before VOI and rejects any model selection outside the admissible set.
forbidden_confounds: Do not hide applicability information from V5_NO_GATE while showing it to V5_FULL.
Do not add extra explanatory text, warnings, examples or prompt language to only one arm.
Do not change the candidate lattice or hypothesis registry between arms.
information_parity.required_parity_test: Serialize the model-visible pre-enforcement scientific payload for both arms and assert byte-identical equality after removing only explicit arm/enforcement identifiers.

historical_v4_manifest_drift_policy.observation: Frozen V4 series manifests may no longer hash-match the current main working tree because later development changed some shared files before V5 implementation began.
required_handling: Do not rewrite historical V4 manifests or frozen run artifacts.
Record the pre-existing drift explicitly as provenance.
A V5-start invariance baseline may be used only to prove that V5 implementation did not further modify the chosen V4 reference files/results.
Do not present the V5-start invariance baseline as a reconstruction or replacement of original V4 provenance.
If an exact historical V4 source tree is later recovered from Git history, record that separately without altering the frozen manifests.

amendment_history.note: Clarifies advice-only versus hard-gate information parity and records the policy for pre-existing V4 manifest drift. No V5 API result existed when amended.
